name: War-Awoken Howling Cherry (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒ハウリングチェリー
effects:
Single-target Ice/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Ice Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has less than 100/50% HP
WS Blue: [During Tactical Awoken Mode, Deadly Strikes +30% to user]
WS Gold: [During Tactical Awoken Mode, Instant Ice & Ability Berserk, and Cap Break Level 4 & Damage +50% to Ice Abilities] to user
